hand-decode: the due-soon reminder sits three days before the end of the 21-day loan period, at 18 days from checkout. The subtraction is over the duration's days field, not over two durations: docs/isa.md section 5 gives subtract clauses for number-number, Date-Date, DateTime-DateTime and Date/DateTime-duration only, so a duration-duration subtraction is a TypeMismatchError and no window can be computed that way. A duration context value is tagged-value encoded; see conformance/README.md

hand-decode: a copy seven days overdue has not yet reached the 28-day point at which the example world declares it lost. The comparison reads the days field of each duration rather than comparing the two durations: docs/isa.md section 5 leaves ordering between two maps, which is what a duration is at the value level, unspecified for siblings
the renewal limit is exclusive at the boundary: the second renewal is the last one allowed, and a third is refused
